title: Expansion over decision tree paths
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $P$ be a finite list of paths, each assigning a terminal output $a_p\in\mathbb{R}$ and a branch value in $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$ or no value at each coordinate. The path expansion is the function on $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$ that sums, over $p\in P$, $a_p$ times the indicator that the input follows the branch values assigned by $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite list of paths in dimension $n$ with real outputs
caveat: The supplied statement refers to the path indicator, whose definition is not included, so its exact condition cannot be rendered from the given formal snippet.
